author: spidey simp
description: A custom Cold War roleplay and grand-strategy system featuring country management, research, industry, national projects, diplomacy, alliances, espionage, historical records, and game-master utilities.
install_msg: SpideyUtils is designed for a custom Cold War roleplay campaign and is not intended for general installation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, usernames, country assignments, roll requests, and roleplay campaign data including research, industry, projects, diplomacy, alliances, espionage, historical records, and other game state.
